title: Tech Note: XML – An Introduction to Extensible Markup Language

historical_commentary.text: XML itself remains a widely used, still-relevant data format (particularly in enterprise, document, and some legacy web-service contexts), and 4D still supports native XML parsing and generation commands today, so the fundamentals covered by this primer remain accurate. However, XML's dominance as the default data-interchange format has been substantially eclipsed by JSON for most modern web/API use cases since this note was written.
related_updates: JSON has become the dominant lightweight data-interchange format for web/API use cases since the early 2000s, though XML remains in active use for documents and some enterprise/legacy integrations
4D's native XML commands introduced around this era are still present and supported in current 4D
